overview: The City Council Committee of the Whole met to discuss and establish collective recommendations for the Fiscal Year 2027 annual budget. The council reviewed various departmental priorities and referred the finalization of the recommendations to the regular council meeting.

items.title: Annual Budget Process for Fiscal Year 2027
items.summary: Referred the budget recommendations to the regular meeting following a discussion of priorities including full funding for public schools, infrastructure improvements, a fire department dive team, and increased librarian wages. Councilors also advocated for several new municipal positions, including a grant writer, an inclusion specialist, a city solicitor, and a city messenger to assist with legislative tasks.
